newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hon Kwok adjusts conversion price of CBs.
newsitem.headline: Hon Kwok adjusts conversion price of CBs.

text.p: Hon Kwok Land Investment Co Ltd said on Thursday it has adjusted the conversion price of two convertible bond issues guaranteed by the company.
The change follows an approval by the company's board of a one-for-10 bonus share issue.

The conversion price for Hon Kwok Land Capital's US$60 million 5.30 percent convertible guaranteed bonds due 2001 convertible into shares of Hon Kwok Land Investment Co has been adjusted to HK$2.720 per share from HK$2.992.

The conversion price for Hon Kwok Land Treasury's US$50 million 4.875 percent convertible guaranteed bonds due 2000 convertible into shares of Hon Kwok Land Investment Co has been adjusted to HK$3.10 per share from HK$3.50 per share.
